context: A Kansai friend rants about his dad with his girlfriend
purpose: Teach: イイ/雑記/ブログランキング/オヤジ/幾ら/つづけ/有無/不快

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: なあ聞いてや、ウチのオヤジまじでムカつくねん、不快やわ。
lines.en: Hey listen, my dad is seriously annoying, so unpleasant.
lines.style: Kansai young male, frustrated venting tone, casual rant

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、また喧嘩したの?何があったか教えて。
lines.en: Aw, did you fight again? Tell me what happened.
lines.style: Soft caring girlfriend, gentle warm concerned voice tone

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 有無を言わさず俺のノート勝手に捨てよったんや、信じられへん。
lines.en: Without asking he just tossed my notebook, unbelievable really.
lines.style: Kansai male, indignant exasperated rant with rising pitch

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひどい!あなたが書きつづけてた雑記みたいなやつでしょ?
lines.en: Awful! That was like the journal you kept writing, right?
lines.style: Sympathetic girlfriend, softly outraged on his behalf gently

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そうやねん、しかも俺のブログランキングのメモまで捨てよってん。
lines.en: Exactly, even my blog ranking notes got tossed too.
lines.style: Kansai male, sulky annoyed with sharp consonants throughout speech

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 幾ら親でもそれはやりすぎだよ、ちゃんと話したの?
lines.en: Even for a parent that's too much, did you talk?
lines.style: Calm reasoning girlfriend, soothing gentle questioning supportive tone

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 話したけどな、『イイ歳して何しとんねん』やとさ。
lines.en: I did, but he just said grown men shouldn't act like that.
lines.style: Kansai male, mimicking gruff dad voice mid-sentence sarcastically

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわぁ、それは傷つくね…でも諦めずに書きつづけてほしいな。
lines.en: Ugh, that hurts, but please keep writing without giving up.
lines.style: Tender encouraging girlfriend, soft warm supportive cadence gentle
